units.source_text: 到了十一月的丰明节，宫中举行五节舞会。

en.t: When the Toyo no Akari festival arrived in the eleventh month, the Five Dances were held at court.
Everyone at court was filled with joyful excitement.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将的两个公子当了殿上童子，入宫时先来六条院参谒。

en.t: General Yugiri's two sons had become palace pages, and before entering the palace they first came to Rokujoin to pay their respects.

units.source_text: 两人年龄相仿，相貌都很秀美。

en.t: The two boys were close in age, and both were graceful and handsome.

units.source_text: 他们的两个母舅头中将和藏人少将陪着同来，都穿白地青色花鸟纹样的小忌衣，风姿十分清丽。

en.t: Their two maternal uncles, the Head Captain and the Minor Captain of the Chamberlains, accompanied them; all wore koimi robes with blue flower and bird patterns on white ground, and their bearing was exceptionally pure and elegant.

units.source_text: 源氏看到他们无忧无虑的模样，不禁回想起少年时代邂逅相逢的筑紫五节舞姬。

en.t: Seeing their carefree appearance, Genji could not help remembering the Five Dances maiden from Tsukushi whom he had happened to meet in his youth.
